title: Watch a rule raise an alarm
description: Unplug a simulated touch panel from its page, open the system it serves, and watch the official reachability rule open a High alarm that takes the system to degraded while you look.

steps.caption: Touch Panel 2 fills the Touch Control role of Media Lab Classroom 2. It reads healthy.
The panel is simulated, so it can be broken on purpose from its own page.
Unplug it. The simulated panel goes dark on every protocol, as if its cable were pulled.
Save. The panel is marked unplugged, and the simulator applies it on its next pull.
Close the simulation. The panel's page lists the systems it serves.
Open the system it serves. It still reads healthy; the official rule waits for a down to hold 15s, so one failed probe never pages.
The down held, so the rule opened a High alarm on the panel. The system's view refreshes on its own, so Why names it with no reload.
The alarm takes the panel out, so Touch Control is short and the system reads degraded.
